metadata.description: Arif Rachim's Claude Code skills: an idea-to-merged-code development loop driven by GitHub issues, with multiple-choice questions instead of open-ended ones.

plugins.name: arif-skills
plugins.description: A development loop as Claude Code skills: grill-me turns an idea into a plan, issues-breakdown into small precise GitHub issues, issues-batch implements a batch of them autonomously on one PR, pr-review gives a merge verdict, issues-sync keeps issues in step with the code, ask-me surfaces decisions waiting on you.
